answer: By the juniper of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a factual sentences, no filler register, it stays short. The gale lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the relic is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt.
